page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor providing 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor subsystem includes 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a 33 MB shared L3 cache. It incorporates instruction extensions including AVX, AVX-512f, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. Compute capacity is paired with 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 8.0 GB of memory per core. The instance provides a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, bundles zero local storage, and includes no dedicated graphics hardware accelerators.

Benchmark measurements indicate modest single-thread and aggregate compute capabilities alongside steady main memory throughput. In raw computational benchmarks, the instance recorded a Geekbench single-core score of 935.0 and a multi-core score of 3552.0, while PassMark registered an overall CPU score of 7037.75 and an extended instructions score of 5864.86. Memory subsystem performance demonstrated balanced large-block throughput, delivering 39.75 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 36.51 GB/sec for uncached writes. Evaluated throughput on Redis SET operations reached 5.94 million operations per second, whereas static web serving achieved 4.05 GB/sec. Large language model execution scaled effectively only on lightweight architectures, delivering 424.94 tokens per second during prompt ingestion on a 135M model, but diminishing to 9.96 tokens per second on a 7B parameter model.

Architecturally, the instance prioritizes memory allocation density over per-core raw clock performance. Because it relies exclusively on remote network-attached volumes for persistent data, storage input and output operations are directly governed by external storage provisioned over network interfaces. Workload suitability centers on in-memory caching layers, medium-scale relational and NoSQL databases, memory-centric enterprise applications, and background ETL batch routines where dataset residency in RAM takes precedence over extreme CPU compute velocity.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized cloud server equipped with 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Configured with a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, it delivers 64.0 GB of system memory backed by 33 MB of L3 cache, a 2 Gbps baseline network interface, zero bundled local storage, and no GPU hardware. Benchmark evaluations show steady memory streaming throughput reaching 39.75 GB/sec on uncached 256 MB reads, alongside modest compute output reflected by a 7037.75 PassMark CPU score and 5.94 million operations per second on Redis SET benchmarks. The instance lacks local disk storage, depending fully on remote block volumes for persistent data operations. It is technically suited for memory-intensive workloads including in-memory datastores, medium caching servers, and memory-bound data processing pipelines.
